title: Platform S — upload your test suite so the extranet live runner executes it (GitHub Actions)
description:
## What this is

The extranet **Testing** tab has a **Run on Dev / Run on Demo** button ([KS-138](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-138/extranet-live-test-runner-trigger-schemathesis-api-e2e-v2-e2e-on)). It triggers a GitHub Actions workflow (`extranet-test-run.yml` in `Secuura/Distributed_Secuura`) that runs test suites **live** against the chosen environment and posts a dashboard back into the portal. Draft workflow + generator are staged in `secuura-extranet/ci/` (`extranet-test-run.yml`, `build-dashboard.mjs`, `README.md`).

This ticket: **add the Platform S test suite** so the runner executes it. (Peter's Platform K suites already exist — see the sibling ticket.)

## How to upload test code so the runner runs it

1. **Commit the suite into the repo** (`Secuura/Distributed_Secuura`, on `main`) — e.g. `systemTest/platform-s/` or `tests/platform-s/`.
2. **Target via env vars, never hardcode** — read the base URL from env so the same code hits dev or demo:
   * Dev API: `https://secuura-dev-api.gentlebush-21213dc4.uksouth.azurecontainerapps.io`
   * Demo API: `https://secuura-demo-api.blackmoss-2a7eea0b.uksouth.azurecontainerapps.io` (and `https://secuura.com` for the app)
   * Use the same `API_BASE_URL` / `BASE_URL` convention the existing suites use.
3. **Runnable headless on an ubuntu GitHub runner** — a deterministic install + run (Node or Python), no GUI, no Chrome-MCP-only steps.
4. **Emit machine-readable results** — a JSON summary (Playwright-style `{stats:{expected,unexpected,skipped}}` is ideal, since the dashboard generator already reads that) plus optionally an HTML report. The runner builds the combined dashboard + posts it back.
5. **No committed credentials** — the harness auto-detects the seeded demo/dev logins from the URL; for authed calls, log in at runtime to get a token.
6. **Wire a workflow step**: add an install+run step for your suite to `extranet-test-run.yml` (gated by the `env` input, `continue-on-error: true`) and point `build-dashboard.mjs` at your results. Ping Kam/Claude and we'll add the step.

## Done when

Platform S tests run green headless against **dev** from the workflow, produce a results JSON the dashboard reads, and appear in the extranet Testing → Platform S tab after a run.

Refs: [KS-138](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-138/extranet-live-test-runner-trigger-schemathesis-api-e2e-v2-e2e-on) (the runner), [KS-136](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-136/platform-s-registration-login-issue-jwt) (Platform S auth/JWT). Sibling: Platform K wiring (Peter).
